articles.title_en: The Isolation index and variations on relative exposure
articles.title_cn: 隔离指数与相对暴露度的变体
articles.abstract_en: We provide an axiomatic characterization of the segregation order represented by the Isolation index, which is increasingly used by economists to measure segregation and related concepts. We extend this result to a broad family of segregation orders that includes the Atkinson and Entropy orders.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了由隔离指数所代表的隔离排序的公理化特征，该指数越来越多地被经济学家用于衡量隔离及相关概念。我们将这一结果扩展到包括阿特金森和熵排序在内的广泛隔离排序族。

articles.title_en: Value of information in social learning
articles.title_cn: 社会学习中的信息价值
articles.abstract_en: This study extends Blackwell (1953) comparison of information to a sequential social learning model in which agents make decisions sequentially based on both private signals and observed actions of others. In this context, we introduce a binary relation over information structures: an information structure is more socially valuable than another if it yields higher expected payoffs for all agents, regardless of their preferences and equilibrium realizations. First, we establish that this binary relation is strictly stronger than the Blackwell order. Next, we provide a necessary and sufficient condition for our binary relation and propose a simpler sufficient condition that is easier to verify. We further explore comparisons of information structures in terms of long-run payoffs, limit welfare, and canonical binary environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究将Blackwell (1953)的信息比较扩展到序贯社会学习模型，在该模型中，代理人基于私人信号和观察到的他人行为依次做出决策。在此背景下，我们引入信息结构上的二元关系：如果一个信息结构对所有代理人产生更高的期望收益，无论其偏好和均衡实现如何，则该信息结构比另一个更具社会价值。首先，我们确定该二元关系严格强于Blackwell序。接下来，我们为我们的二元关系提供必要且充分的条件，并提出一个更简单且易于验证的充分条件。我们进一步探讨了信息结构在长期收益、极限福利和典型二元环境中的比较。

articles.title_en: Intergenerational cultural transmission with social interactions as an evolutionary game
articles.title_cn: 代际文化传递与社会互动的演化博弈
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a multi-trait cultural transmission model with social interactions. The resulting cultural dynamic is equivalent to an evolutionary dynamic on a population game that combines social payoffs and cultural biases. This transformation allows us to apply tools from evolutionary game theory to examine cultural homogeneity and heterogeneity. We show that when social interactions have a coordination nature, cultural biases can push the cultural dynamic toward selecting a culturally homogeneous equilibrium that is efficient for those interactions. In contrast, when interactions have an anti-coordination nature, cultural biases usually drive the dynamic toward a culturally heterogeneous state that differs from the efficient equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个具有社会互动的多特征文化传递模型。由此产生的文化动态等价于一个结合了社会收益和文化偏好的种群博弈上的演化动态。这一转换使我们能够运用演化博弈论的工具来考察文化的同质性与异质性。我们表明，当社会互动具有协调性质时，文化偏好可以推动文化动态趋向于选择一个对这些互动而言高效的文化同质均衡。相反，当互动具有反协调性质时，文化偏好通常会使动态趋向于一个不同于高效均衡的文化异质状态。

articles.abstract_en: In finite problems comprising objects, cases, and an object- and case-contingent payoff function, we study the comparative statics of the set of undominated objects, meaning those for which there exists no mixture over objects that is superior in every case. We consider both weak and strict dominance (corresponding to different degrees of ‘strictness’ in the definition of superiority). Our main theorem characterises those payoff transformations which robustly expand the not-weakly-dominated and not-strictly-dominated sets: the necessary and sufficient condition is that payoffs be transformed separately across cases, in either a monotone–concave or a constant manner. We apply our results to Pareto frontiers and games.
articles.abstract_cn: 在由对象、情形以及依赖于对象和情形的收益函数构成的有限问题中，我们研究了无优势对象集合的比较静态性质，其中无优势对象是指不存在任何在每种情形下都更优的对象混合。我们同时考虑弱优势和严格优势（对应于优势定义中‘严格性’的不同程度）。我们的主要定理刻画了那些能够稳健地扩大非弱优势和非严格优势集合的收益变换：必要且充分条件是收益在每种情形下分别进行变换，且变换方式要么是单调凹的，要么是常数形式的。我们将结果应用于帕累托前沿和博弈。
